series_title: Upon This Winter's Night: The Story of Julian Rowlands
series_description: The complete origin narrative behind The Arctic Symphony Project (originally formed as The Winter Palace) and their 3-disc symphonic rock opera 'Tales from the Solstice'. When fourteen-year-old Julian Thomas Rowlands ('Julep')—who is non-verbal, autistic, and uses a manual wheelchair—is abducted from Ewell, Virginia on December 11, 1996 by his estranged father, his fierce twin siblings Gabriel and Gwendolyn Rowlands and his twin anchors Maria and Clara Harrison turn their living room into a war room and broadcast a symphonic rock rescue beacon across the Appalachian radio towers. Spanning from Julian's 1996 abduction and Ohio rescue, the forging of the vaulted Trilingual 'Family Mix' in Cymraeg, Québécois French, and English, and the family's 1998 return to Anglesey, Wales, to their 2007 meeting in Williamsburg with Samantha, Jyn, and Matthew—whose cross-country abduction from Norfolk to Seattle was survived using Julian's song as his sonic armor.
